courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Fundamentals of Musicianship I
courses.description: First semester of integrated sequence in music theory, aural training, music technology, and music literature.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Fundamentals of Musicianship II
courses.description: Second semester of integrated sequence in music theory, aural training, music technology, and music literature.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MUSI 2010 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Fundamentals of Musicianship III
courses.description: The third semester of integrated sequence in music theory, aural training, music technology, and music literature; focused on advanced theory, history, and technology topics.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MUSI 2011 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Fundamentals of Musicianship IV
courses.description: The fourth semester of integrated sequence in music theory, aural training, music technology, and music literature; focused on comprehensive and innovative music discussions.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MUSI 2012 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Laptop Orchestra
courses.description: Analysis, rehearsal, creation, and performance of music for laptop orchestra.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MUSI 2010 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: History of Popular Music: 1960–Present
courses.description: History of Pop music from 1960–present. American, European, and Afro-diasporic music explored in context with political and socioeconomic structures. Includes creation of original music.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Introduction Audio Technology I
courses.description: Critical understanding of, and hands-on experience with the fundamentals of analog audio technology. Topics include signals and systems, electro-acoustics, sound effects, synthesis and music protocols.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MATH 1552 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Introduction to Audio Technology II
courses.description: Critical understanding of, and hands-on experience with the fundamentals of digital audio technology. Topics include sampling, quantization, digital effects, music information retrieval and audio coding.
courses.prereqGT: Undergraduate Semester level MUSI 2525 Minimum Grade of D

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Introduction to Music Theory
courses.description: Introduction to music theory including basic notation, scales, key signatures, trials, roman numeral analysis, and voice leading in four-part harmony.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Marching Band
courses.description: This course will prepare various traditional and contemporary music for scheduled performances throughout the semester in support various athletic events and School of Music concerts.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Pep Band
courses.description: This course will prepare a variety of traditional and contemporary music for scheduled performances throughout the semester in support of various athletic events and School of Music concerts.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Concert Band
courses.description: An advanced instrumental ensemble performing traditional and contemporary wind literature. Offered to all students with woodwind, brass, or percussion experience. Audition required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Symphonic Band
courses.description: An advanced instrumental ensemble performing traditional and contemporary wind literature. Offered to all students with woodwind, brass, or percussion experience. Audition required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Chamber Choir
courses.description: An auditioned mixed ensemble focused upon the rehearsal, study and performance of choral music. Repertoire varies from various style eras and genres.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Chorale
courses.description: A non-auditioned mixed ensemble focused upon the rehearsal, study and performance of choral music. Repertoire varies from various style eras and genres.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Glee Club
courses.description: A non-auditioned male ensemble focused upon the rehearsal, study and performance of choral music. Repertoire varies from various style eras and genres.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Treble Choir
courses.description: A non-auditioned TREBLE ensemble focused upon the rehearsal, study and performance of choral music. Repertoire varies from various style eras and genres.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Jazz Ensemble
courses.description: Jazz Ensemble explores music from the 1920's to the present, focusing on ensemble playing and improvisation.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Jazz Combo
courses.description: Jazz Combos explore small group jazz focusing on ensemble playing and improvisation.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Chamber Ensemble
courses.description: An advanced ensemble performing traditional and contemporary chamber ensemble literature. Audition and permit required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Survey of Music Technology
courses.description: Creative practices and technical pursuits in the inherently interdisciplinary world of music technology. Hands-on projects which explore key concepts, essential tools, and creative techniques.

courses.subject: MUSI

courses.description: An advanced instrumental ensemble performing traditional and contemporary percussion literature. Offered to all students with percussion experience. Audition required.

courses.description: An advanced instrumental chamber ensemble that performs new and contemporary literature often using technology. Offered to all students with advanced performing experience. Audition required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Electronic Percussion Ensemble
courses.description: An advanced instrumental ensemble performing percussion literature using student designed and built instruments, interfaces and software, as well as commercially available controllers. Offered to all students with percussion experience. Audition required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Rock and Pop Ensemble
courses.description: A contemporary popular music ensemble performing historical and current popular music. Offered to all students with advanced performing experience. Audition required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Symphony Orchestra
courses.description: An advanced instrumental ensemble performing traditional and contemporary literature. Offered to all students with string, woodwind, brass, or percussion experience. Audition required.

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Musicians & their Music

courses.subject: MUSI
courses.title: Digital Signal Processing for Music Analysis and Synthesis
courses.description: Research in music, as well as music production and composition increasingly relies on sophiticated digital signal processing techniques. This course will review fundamental elements of digital audio signal processing, such as sinusoids, spectra, digital filters, and Fourier analysis and their application to the fundamental music analysis problems of modeling and synthesis. The course will focus particularly on the algorithmic implementation sound transformation and synthesis techniques through intensive programming assignments in Matlab and CSound.
